en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard divided into four panels. The upper left view shows a domed tower structure overlooking a town and river valley, labeled "Jacobstein." The upper right view shows a hillside manor or small castle with a tower, surrounded by terraced vineyards, labeled "Friedensburg." The lower left view portrays a curving river with a bridge in the foreground and a settlement on the hillside, labeled "Die Lößnitz." The lower right view shows a panoramic view of a town with a church spire and a river bend in the background, labeled "Radebeul-West." All captions appear in German.
